# Implementation Skill

## Objective

Implement only the approved implementation plan.

## Rules

- Read all approved SDLC artifacts.
- Inspect existing patterns before changing code.
- Make minimal changes.
- Preserve existing behavior.
- Add tests for new behavior.
- Avoid unrelated refactoring.
- Follow Spring Boot conventions.
- Report deviations.

## Testing

Implementation must create/update tests.

Final verification is owned by the verification skill.

## Security

Never commit secrets.

Never copy credentials from MCP responses into source code.

## Completion

Report:

- completed tasks
- changed files
- tests added
- deviations
- remaining work
